name: Ego state
oneLine: A coherent, consistent set of behaviours, thoughts and feelings that show up together - not a role you're playing, and not Freud's superego, ego or id.
whatYouDid: You watched Dev's "fine, whatever" and had to judge it as a whole bundle - tone, posture and words together - not as a sentence on its own.
confusion: People often hear "ego state" and think "role", or map it straight onto Freud's superego/ego/id; the tell is that an ego state is defined by which actual behaviours, thoughts and feelings travel together in you specifically, not by a social role or a generalized psychic agency everyone shares the same way.

fromBook.quote: An ego-state is a set of related behaviors, thoughts and feelings.

expand.definition: Berne's full definition: a consistent pattern of feeling and experience directly related to a corresponding consistent pattern of behavior - the feelings and the behaviour travel together, reliably, as a set.
expand.otherFraming: TA Today is explicit that this is not Freud's superego/ego/id: those are generalized, purely theoretical agencies, while Parent, Adult and Child point to specific, actual people - your actual parents, your actual childhood - and are judged from observable behaviour rather than theorized.
expand.tryThisToday: Next time you notice a feeling in yourself, check whether a matching set of behaviours shows up with it - that pairing is the ego state, not the feeling alone.
